data.description:
Found while verifying d724 AC10 against Windows sweep 35551741150.

tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store fails on Windows because the runner has no usable OpenSSH / ssh-keygen at version 8.9 or newer, which opcert signing requires.

This is a missing precondition, so the test fails where it should either skip with a clear reason or the workflow should provision OpenSSH. A hard failure here hides whether per-store opcert key isolation actually holds on Windows.

Not the d724 defect class.
data.title: Windows runner lacks ssh-keygen >= 8.9 for opcert signing tests
